summary: 7 film announcements, 8 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: Thud
film.talent: Sarah Michelle Gellar, Rudy Pankow, Steve Agee, Karan Soni, and seven additional cast members
film.announcement: Grim Reaper-Devil romance film adds seven actors to cast alongside Gellar and Pankow.

film.title: Show of Hands
film.announcement: Frank Grillo to lead political kidnapping comedy directed by P.J. Pesce.

film.title: Milliseconds
film.talent: Billy Zane, John Billingsley, Scottie Thompson, Bonnie Root, Philippe Caland (director)
film.announcement: Neo-noir thriller directed by Philippe Caland adds Billy Zane, John Billingsley, Scottie Thompson, and Bonnie Root to cast.

film.title: The Thomas Crown Affair
film.announcement: First trailer released for Michael B. Jordan's reimagining of The Thomas Crown Affair, in which he also directs himself.

film.title: American Summer
film.announcement: Family comedy starring Steve Guttenberg and Christie Brinkley lands theatrical release.

film.title: The Conjuring: First Communion
film.talent: Charles Parnell, Marta Kessler, Caleb Dolden
film.announcement: The Conjuring: First Communion rounds out cast with Charles Parnell, Marta Kessler, and Caleb Dolden.

film.title: Jumanji: Open World
film.announcement: New trailer released for Jumanji: Open World showing the virtual world becoming reality.

tv.title: Chad Powers
tv.announcement: Season 2 gets fall release date with first look photos showing Glen Powell leading South Georgia Catfish to college football playoffs.

tv.title: Reacher
tv.talent: Jay Baruchel, Kevin Durand, Amanda Ip, Ciara Bravo
tv.announcement: Season 5 casting announced with Jay Baruchel, Kevin Durand, Amanda Ip, and Ciara Bravo joining the cast.

tv.title: Young Sherlock
tv.talent: Sophie Skelton, Indira Varma, Olivia Williams, Aidan Gillen
tv.announcement: Season 2 adds Sophie Skelton, Indira Varma, Olivia Williams, and Aidan Gillen to cast; some returning cast members not coming back.

tv.title: Robin Hood
tv.announcement: Graeme Thomas King upped to series regular for Season 2, playing Prince John.

tv.title: American Idol
tv.announcement: Renewed for Season 25 with auditions kicking off in August.

tv.title: Thunder Road
tv.announcement: AMC NASCAR series casts Silo star Shane McRae.

tv.title: Pinotphile
tv.announcement: Irish comedian Joanne McNally inks Netflix deal for debut hour special Pinotphile.

tv.title: Best in Class
tv.announcement: Comcast's Xfinity launches creator reality series hosted by Katie Feeney.
